name: hei5enbug-agent-setup
description: Portable agent skills for repeatable engineering and documentation workflows.

agent_guard.title: Block built-in subagents
agent_guard.description: Hide the built-in general-purpose, Explore, Plan, and claude agents and deny forked subagents so work goes to the plugin's scout and worker agents.

role_pinning.title: Pin role models
role_pinning.description: Run the scout, worker, sonnet-worker, designer, and reviewer agents on their pinned model and effort, and stop an agent that runs on any other model.

risk_highlight.title: Risk labels on tool calls
risk_highlight.description: Label tool-call rows in the transcript from the approval guard's classification: red for calls it asks about every time or treats as critical, with a read-only preview of what they would discard or delete, and yellow for writes. Reads get no label, and nothing is added to the model's context.

work_board.title: Work board
work_board.description: Add the /work-board pane that lists subagents with their status, elapsed time, and edited files, marks files two active owners edit, and shows context, Claude and Codex usage, limit pace, and the prompt-cache hit rate; while subagents run or files conflict, show a one-line summary above the prompt.

implementation_worker.title: Implementation worker
implementation_worker.description: Route implementation work: auto (the main session picks per task: haiku for easy work, sonnet for normal or hard work, and sol only when a Claude route fails or stops on a usage limit), codex (Codex on gpt-5.6-luna at high), haiku (the plugin worker on its Worker model and Worker effort, claude-haiku-5-5 at high by default), sol (gpt-6.1-sol at high through the role runner), or sonnet (the plugin sonnet-worker on claude-sonnet-5-5 at high).

worker_model.title: Worker model
worker_model.description: Model of the plugin worker agent in Claude Code. Takes effect after /reload-plugins or in a new session.

worker_effort.title: Worker effort
worker_effort.description: Reasoning effort of the plugin worker agent in Claude Code. Takes effect after /reload-plugins or in a new session.

codex_worker_model.title: Codex worker model
codex_worker_model.description: Model of the plugin worker role in Codex. Codex reads it at session start, so it takes effect from the next Codex session. HEI5ENBUG_CODEX_WORKER_MODEL overrides it.

codex_worker_effort.title: Codex worker effort
codex_worker_effort.description: Reasoning effort of the plugin worker role in Codex, from the next Codex session. HEI5ENBUG_CODEX_WORKER_EFFORT overrides it.

review_model.title: Review model
review_model.description: Model that runs independent validation and skill review roles at xhigh. GPT models run through codex exec and Claude models through claude -p.

language_guard.title: Response language guard
language_guard.description: Block or remind when a reply is not written in the configured response language.

datagrip_guard.title: DataGrip query guard
datagrip_guard.description: Run DataGrip reads without approval with a 60-second PostgreSQL limit; use the session write approval for writes and for every query on a data source marked as needing approval; ask every time for destructive queries.

approval_guard.title: Approval guard
approval_guard.description: Run covered CLI, script, database, and MCP reads without approval; ask once per session for all writes, including production changes and git pushes, and once per session for sensitive reads such as .env files; ask every time for force pushes, discarding uncommitted work, recursive deletion outside the session or temporary folders, destructive database statements, remote infrastructure deletion, package publishing, and docker or curl deletion; deny secret-printing commands and approval-state edits.

approval_scope.title: Approval scope
approval_scope.description: tiered: ask once per session for writes and sensitive reads and every time for the every-time actions; session: one approval covers the rest of the session, except discarding uncommitted work, destructive SQL on a production connection, and production infrastructure deletion, which ask every time.

orca_worktree.title: Orca worktrees for other repositories
orca_worktree.description: Before changing another Git repository, hand the change to a new Orca worktree of that repository with its own agent session instead of editing an existing checkout.

host_settings.title: Host settings
host_settings.description: apply: at session start, back up and fix the allowlisted host settings that cause extra approval prompts; report: only report them.

python.title: Hook Python interpreter
python.description: Absolute path of a Python 3.12+ interpreter, with pglast for the SQL guard, that the plugin hooks use instead of python3; an empty or invalid value falls back to python3.

refresh_plugins.title: Plugins refreshed with this one
refresh_plugins.description: Other installed plugins, as comma-separated plugin@marketplace IDs, that orca-plugin-refresh updates and validates with this plugin. On Codex, the HEI5ENBUG_REFRESH_PLUGINS environment variable sets it.
